checks.name: CK_attachments_entity_type
checks.definition: ([entity_type]='TASK' OR [entity_type]='REQUEST' OR [entity_type]='STOCK_DOCUMENT' OR [entity_type]='ASSET' OR [entity_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [entity_type]='INCIDENT' OR [entity_type]='INSPECTION' OR [entity_type]='CLEANING_TASK' OR [entity_type]='ROOM')

checks.name: CK_audit_logs_action
checks.definition: ([action]='LOGOUT' OR [action]='LOGIN' OR [action]='CANCEL' OR [action]='REJECT' OR [action]='APPROVE' OR [action]='DELETE' OR [action]='UPDATE' OR [action]='CREATE')

checks.name: CK_incident_events_to_status
checks.definition: ([to_status] IS NULL OR ([to_status]='CANCELLED' OR [to_status]='CLOSED' OR [to_status]='RESOLVED' OR [to_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [to_status]='OPEN'))

checks.name: CK_internal_requests_status
checks.definition: ([status]='CANCELLED' OR [status]='REJECTED' OR [status]='CLOSED' OR [status]='COMPLETED' OR [status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [status]='SUBMITTED' OR [status]='DRAFT')

checks.name: CK_replenishment_lines_source
checks.definition: ([source_type]='LOW_STOCK' AND [source_threshold_id] IS NOT NULL AND [source_material_request_line_id] IS NULL OR [source_type]='MATERIAL_REQUEST_SHORTAGE' AND [source_material_request_line_id] IS NOT NULL AND [source_threshold_id] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_replenishments_closure
checks.definition: ([status]='CLOSED' AND [closed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [closed_by] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim(rtrim([close_reason])))>=(10) AND [close_reason] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'CLOSED' AND [closed_at] IS NULL AND [closed_by] IS NULL AND [close_reason] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_material_request_lines_quantities
checks.definition: ([requested_qty]>(0) AND [fulfilled_qty]>=(0) AND ([approved_qty] IS NULL OR [approved_qty]>=(0) AND [approved_qty]<=[requested_qty]) AND [fulfilled_qty]<=coalesce([approved_qty],(0)))

checks.name: CK_material_requests_status
checks.definition: ([status]='COMPLETED' OR [status]='PARTIALLY_FULFILLED' OR [status]='RETURNED' OR [status]='SUBMITTED' OR [status]='CANCELLED' OR [status]='REJECTED' OR [status]='REMAINDER_CLOSED' OR [status]='FULLY_ISSUED' OR [status]='PARTIALLY_ISSUED' OR [status]='APPROVED' OR [status]='NEEDS_INFORMATION' OR [status]='PENDING_APPROVAL' OR [status]='DRAFT')

checks.name: CK_operational_task_progress_new
checks.definition: ([new_status] IS NULL OR ([new_status]='CANCELLED' OR [new_status]='COMPLETED' OR [new_status]='BLOCKED' OR [new_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [new_status]='TODO'))

checks.name: CK_operational_task_progress_old
checks.definition: ([old_status] IS NULL OR ([old_status]='CANCELLED' OR [old_status]='COMPLETED' OR [old_status]='BLOCKED' OR [old_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [old_status]='TODO'))

checks.name: CK_operational_tasks_source_type
checks.definition: ([source_type] IS NULL OR ([source_type]='MANUAL' OR [source_type]='INTERNAL_REQUEST' OR [source_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [source_type]='INSPECTION' OR [source_type]='CLEANING'))

checks.name: CK_room_inspections_status_result
checks.definition: ([status]='COMPLETED' AND [result] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'COMPLETED' AND [result] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_room_status_history_from
checks.definition: ([from_status] IS NULL OR ([from_status]='OUT_OF_SERVICE' OR [from_status]='READY' OR [from_status]='INSPECTION' OR [from_status]='CLEANING' OR [from_status]='DIRTY' OR [from_status]='OCCUPIED' OR [from_status]='AVAILABLE'))

checks.name: CK_room_status_history_to
checks.definition: ([to_status]='OUT_OF_SERVICE' OR [to_status]='READY' OR [to_status]='INSPECTION' OR [to_status]='CLEANING' OR [to_status]='DIRTY' OR [to_status]='OCCUPIED' OR [to_status]='AVAILABLE')

checks.name: CK_room_status_history_trigger_type
checks.definition: ([trigger_type] IS NULL OR ([trigger_type]='MANUAL_CORRECTION' OR [trigger_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [trigger_type]='ROOM_BLOCK' OR [trigger_type]='INSPECTION' OR [trigger_type]='CLEANING_TASK' OR [trigger_type]='CHECKOUT' OR [trigger_type]='CHECKIN' OR [trigger_type]='RELEASE' OR [trigger_type]='INIT'))

checks.name: CK_rooms_operational_status
checks.definition: ([operational_status]='OUT_OF_SERVICE' OR [operational_status]='READY' OR [operational_status]='INSPECTION' OR [operational_status]='CLEANING' OR [operational_status]='DIRTY' OR [operational_status]='OCCUPIED' OR [operational_status]='AVAILABLE')
